title: Tiny shift rituals and micro-batch checklist
content:
Morning checklist (5-7 min)
- Quick prod-health: /health and /metrics summary (p99, p95, req/s)
- Check alerts channel: slack thread "#runtime-alerts" - note any new alerts since 05:30 PT
- Look at rolling deploys: console -> routes -> last 24h failures
- KV cache hit ratio snapshot (last 1h): `curl -s http://ops/metrics | jq .kv_cache.hitrate` -> if < 0.85 open a ticket

Today focus
- Finish micro-batch cutoff experiment (A/B): compare batch_size=8 vs 12 under synthetic load
- Follow up on intermittent segfault seen on gpu-node-7 at 02:14 UTC
- Trim long-tail latency: identify requests with > 500ms token generation

Notes on segfault (gpu-node-7)
- Repro attempts: couldn't reproduce locally. Happened once after warm restart of runtime service.
- Stack hint: looks like hook in cuBLAS on quantized path (int8). See related PR #4821
- Quick triage steps:
  1) Pull dmesg and last core dump: `gcore` if present; copy to /tmp/evan-cores/
  2) Check driver/kernels: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv` vs node baseline image
  3) Run small load with model-x-int8 on node with env VAR DEBUG=1

Micro-batching experiment plan
- Hypothesis: batch_size=12 reduces token-cost by ~18% while keeping P99 increase < 10%
- Test harness: ab-latency-runner@staging -> run for 15m at 250rps
- Metrics to collect: p50/p95/p99, avg tokens per req, GPU util, queue-time
- Safety: if p99 increases > 15% abort early and revert config
- TODO: add logging for per-batch assembly latency (instrument in batcher.cpp lines ~218-236)

Open questions / TODO
- Q: Does KV cache TTL interact with batch coalescing? (ask @Marco to trace cache headers)
- Q: Should we cap batch size at route-level for low-latency customers? (product discussion)
- TODO: Create quick playbook for oncall to toggle batch-size via runtime flag (feature: route.batch_override)
- TODO: Upload kernel stack trace to ticket JIRA-RUNTIME-1829

Hand-off for evening shift
- Current experiment running: micro-batch-a/b (ID: mb-exp-20260313-09)
- If p99 spikes > 20%: flip both nodes to batch_size=8, notify #runtime-alerts and leave note in ticket
- If segfault reappears: isolate node and attach core to ticket, tag @SRE oncall

Random thoughts (brain dump)
- Maybe we should expose a "sensitivity" score per route that suggests safe max batch_size based on observed tail-latency and cold-start rate.
- Small change: log approximate token-length distribution per 5m window instead of per-request to reduce s3 cost

End notes
- Logged experiment config to /mnt/experiments/mb-exp-20260313-09/config.json
- Leaving a snippet to follow up: `grep -n "assemble_batch" -r src | sed -n '1,120p'`
